action.message: NCCP and EMA specify withholding cabozantinib at least 28 days before planned surgery, including dental surgery, if possible. Restart depends on adequate healing; wound complications requiring medical intervention require discontinuation.

action.message: Grade 3–4 toxicity requires the interruption/restart pathway except clinically non-relevant laboratory abnormalities. Confirm clinical relevance, recovery and previous dose before selecting a numeric restart dose.

action.message: Interrupt clinically relevant grade 3–4 toxicity; treat symptoms. Restart at a lower dose only after recovery to grade ≤1. Unresolved grade 4 toxicity requires permanent discontinuation.

action.message: Interrupt severe toxicity and provide supportive care. Restart only after recovery to grade ≤1, normally at a lower dose: 60→40→20 mg daily; a third reduction requires discontinuation.

eligibility: Advanced clear-cell renal cell carcinoma after prior VEGF-targeted therapy
Adequate organ and haematological function; source exclusions and prior-treatment criteria must be checked.
exclusions: Known hypersensitivity to a regimen component
Pregnancy or breastfeeding where prohibited by the current source
Regimen-specific exclusions encoded in the assessment

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Current source-specific support plan; verify local prescription.
supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for oral SACT
premedication: Arrange the baseline dental assessment and tell your dentist about treatment. No routine infusion premedication is required.
other_support: Report diarrhoea and painful palms/soles early. Confirm your prescribed symptom medicines and blood-pressure plan. Tell the team before surgery or dental procedures: treatment usually needs withholding at least 28 days beforehand, with restart only after review of healing.

treatment_phases.name: Continuous oral treatment

administration.notes: No food for two hours before and one hour after; tablets are not interchangeable with capsules.

treatment_phases.label: 60 mg once daily continuously; no planned rest week
treatment_phases.summary: Continue until progression or unacceptable toxicity, with individual prescribing review.

baseline: Full blood count, kidney, liver and bone profile, blood glucose, urine protein, thyroid tests, blood pressure, heart tracing (ECG) and dental examination.
regular: Full blood count, kidney, liver and bone profile monthly; magnesium, urine protein, thyroid tests and blood pressure monthly. Repeat heart tracing and dental examination as clinically indicated.
monitoring.disease_monitoring: Symptoms and scans are interpreted together. Your consultant sets imaging timing according to the treatment plan; this regimen does not mandate a universal three-month scan interval.
